title: wmp.flow.complete — Notification
description: Flow reached a terminal state successfully.

credentials.description: OpenID4VCI flows: the issued credentials. When credential_response_encrypted is true the entries carry no credential value.

credential_response_encrypted.description: OpenID4VCI flows: true when the issuer's response was encrypted to a key only the client holds and the server relayed it unread. credentials[] entries then carry no credential value and credential_metadata is absent; the client pairs credentials[i] with the i-th credential it decrypted.

credential_metadata.description: OpenID4VCI flows: only for a plain (unencrypted) issuer response, the display-only members (display, claims) of its response-level credential_metadata. Never present when credential_response_encrypted is true; never carries org.siros.secret_seed or auxiliary_data (or any member an implementation configures as secret-bearing).

refresh_token.description: OpenID4VCI flows: issuer refresh token. A secret; withheld from replayed completions.

dpop_jwk.description: OpenID4VCI flows: private JWK of the DPoP key the refresh token is bound to. A secret; withheld from replayed completions.

dpop_key_id.description: OpenID4VCI flows: identifier of the client-held DPoP key. Withheld from replayed completions.

credential_response_encryption_jwk.description: Sign flows (generate_proof): the client's fresh ephemeral public response-encryption JWK. Absent or empty means declined.

transaction_id.description: Sign flows (decrypt_credential_response): set when the issuer deferred issuance. Never together with credential_count.

interval.description: Sign flows (decrypt_credential_response): optional polling interval in seconds, with transaction_id.

credential_count.description: Sign flows (decrypt_credential_response): the number of credentials the decrypted response held. Never together with transaction_id.

response_jwe.description: Sign flows (sign_presentation, response_mode direct_post.jwt): the finished compact JWE the orchestrator relays to the verifier unread. Five base64url segments; only the encrypted key of a direct ECDH-ES agreement may be empty. Never together with vp_token.

redacted_members.description: Set only on a replayed completion: the secret members withheld from the retained copy.

allOf.description: A seed is never relayed in a completion; it travels only in an encrypted issuer response that the client decrypts itself.
A decrypt_credential_response result reports a transaction_id or a credential_count, never both.
An interval belongs only to a deferred result: it requires transaction_id, and so (with the rule above) is never present with credential_count.
A sign_presentation result for an encrypted response mode carries response_jwe and no vp_token: the orchestrator cannot decrypt the value and never builds the response itself.
A decrypt_credential_response result carries control members only: the decrypted credentials and credential_metadata never go back to the orchestrator.
